text:
Amanda: quick sync — did a cost vs quality sweep for Llama-13B and Llama-7B variants (fp16 vs int8/nf4) across chat and batch-embed workloads. summary below we can use for routing decisions.

Jeremy: nice, paste the numbers when you have them.

Amanda: pasted the compact table from local evals + small human A/B (200 prompts). hardware: A100x2, prod-like IO.

Amanda: ```
MODEL | CONFIG        | LATENCY(ms/token) | COST($/1k_tok) | HUMAN_HELP(0..1)
13B   | fp16 (baseline)| 12.8             | 0.22           | 0.92
13B   | int8 (nf4)     | 9.6              | 0.12           | 0.89
7B    | fp16           | 8.2              | 0.08           | 0.82
7B    | int8           | 6.4              | 0.05           | 0.79
```

Li: how was HUMAN_HELP scored?

Amanda: pairwise A/B. raters choose which reply they'd prefer for helpfulness and factuality; we convert to a 0..1 preference score. 200 diverse prompts, stratified by length and instruction type.

Sanjay: good. any regression patterns on long-context (>1024) prompts?

Amanda: small quality drop for int8 on very long context: ~0.02 absolute vs fp16 on the 13B case. p95 latency increases ~+1.2ms/token due to KV handling but still cheaper.

Jeremy: unit economics question — what does $/1k_tok assume?

Amanda: includes GPU amortized + infra (network + worker) + storage delta. rough formula: (GPU_hour_cost/throughput_tokens_per_hour) + infra_flat. numbers are conservative (rounded up).

Sanjay: routing reco (quick):
- webchat low-latency: 13B int8 (nf4) — best latency/cost while keeping quality ~0.89
- premium/high-accuracy: 13B fp16 — keep for paid tiers or when quality delta >0.02 matters
- bulk embeddings / background jobs: 7B int8 — lowest $/token

Amanda: also add fallback: if model failure/latency spike -> route to 13B fp16 in another region or lower concurrency slot. Canary rollout plan: 5% of traffic, monitor HUMAN_HELP delta and error rate.

Jeremy: what thresholds for auto-rollback?

Amanda: trigger if HUMAN_HELP drops by >0.02 (absolute) vs baseline on canary set OR error rate >1% OR latency p95 regression >25%.

Li: for product/GTN guidance, we should produce a one-page scorecard for each route listing cost delta, expected latency, and risk notes. I can draft if you add the fine-grained numbers (p50/p95/cost breakouts).

Amanda: will export p50/p95 traces + per-route cost breakdown by EOD and drop in the drive.

EvalBot: automated eval finished — rouge/bleu trends consistent with human prefs; int8 shows slight lexical variability but no major hallucination uplift.

Sanjay: perfect. next step: Amanda to push scorecards to /shared/eng-ml/route-scorecards, Li to prepare GTN blurb, Jeremy to schedule 1-week canary after infra tickets cleared. :thumbsup:

Jeremy: thanks — this helps a lot.
